description: Data Quality Configuration for Oncology SLM Data Engineering

rejection_codes.EMPTY_REPORT: Clinical report text is null, NaN, or whitespace only
rejection_codes.EMPTY_SUMMARY: Target summary text is null, NaN, or whitespace only
rejection_codes.INVALID_PATIENT_ID: Patient ID does not conform to regex pattern SYNTH_PAT_XXXXX
rejection_codes.INVALID_RECORD_ID: Record ID does not conform to regex pattern SYNTH_REC_XXXXXX
rejection_codes.REPORT_TOO_SHORT: Clinical report character length below min_report_characters
rejection_codes.REPORT_TOO_LONG: Clinical report character length exceeds max_report_characters
rejection_codes.SUMMARY_TOO_SHORT: Target summary character length below min_summary_characters
rejection_codes.SUMMARY_TOO_LONG: Target summary character length exceeds max_summary_characters
rejection_codes.SENTENCE_COUNT_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Target summary sentence count outside [min_summary_sentences, max_summary_sentences]
rejection_codes.EXACT_DUPLICATE: Exact duplicate row or duplicate report-summary pair
rejection_codes.CONFLICTING_SUMMARY_DUPLICATE: Identical clinical report text with contradictory target summaries
rejection_codes.EXTREME_LENGTH_RATIO: Ratio of report length to summary length outside reasonable bounds
rejection_codes.PII_DETECTED: Unsanitized synthetic personal identifiable information pattern detected
